It will also be useful for anyone else who from time to time needs to commission an index from a professional indexer.

Indexpurpose of Index usability For many, the art and science of indexing is opaque. Our goal, therefore, is to provide you with basic information about what an index is and what it is not, how it serves its readers, and, perhaps most importantly, how to evaluate and edit an index that has been submitted to you.

Because the specific contexts (business, content, and users) differ for each index, it is difficult to provide answers that apply to all cases. But we can and have given you guidelines as to best practices.

Framing all of our discussions is the importance of index usability. Readers and users of indexes must be able to find the information they need easily and efficiently. If an index doesn’t fulfill that basic purpose, then its value as a significant information finding tool is severely compromised.
